nodes.title:
Select whether the foot is planted or about to plant when stopping using the foot planted curve. A value >= 0.5 means the foot is planted, and a value < 0.5 means the foot is still in the air. 

The foot planted curve also determines which foot is planted (or about to plant). Positive values mean the right foot is planted, negative values mean the left.
